findings: FrameIsometry constructs actual synthesis and analysis from the supplied orthonormal frame. Norm preservation is the exact finite orthonormal norm-square identity; the true range is its normal span, and the inverse statement is restricted to that span.

RidgeTripleGrouping proves the full ordered-cube permutation identities directly. The three cyclic/swap sums equal the original cube sum, so the existing factor one-half becomes one-sixth. No pair-density symmetry or geometric cancellation is assumed, and absolute values are taken only after combining the three genuine incidences.

IndependentTriples reindexes the cube via an actual Fin3-function/product equivalence, then restricts only after pointwise dependent contributions have been proved zero. The finite independent subtype is allowed to be empty in ambient rank below three, and injectivity of each retained selected index map follows from actual normal independence.

RidgeAtoms expands the actual guarded third-boundary atom into angle times shifted level times raw density, then invokes the genuine checked finite-section mass identity including its residual-scale divisor. Repeated indices vanish by guards; zero third residuals vanish under the explicitly retained ordinary local slack condition.

RidgeIndependentGrouping first obtains one common almost-everywhere threshold set for the finite family of all selected tuples. Genuine zero-of-dependent proofs justify restriction before the one-sixth absolute grouped bound. There is no frame or cone requirement on dependent tuples.

RidgeMeasurable writes the actual section integrands as jointly measurable functions in threshold and Gaussian residual and integrates them against the fixed Gaussian law. This gives measurability even where Bochner integral totalization would apply, without asserting integrability or changing the hard inequalities.

RidgeRegularity transfers any measurable volume-almost-everywhere threshold property through actual invertible affine standardization at each fixed base and then uses product Fubini. The arbitrary base is merely SFinite and can be singular; sigma is explicitly nonzero. The specialization supplies exactly ordinary pair residual regularity and every selected triple condition.
qualifications: This review is source-independent for these seven parent-authored modules. The packet supplies exact algebraic grouping, support restriction, measurability, and generic affine-threshold regularity. It does not alone establish the common-mass-to-tube comparison or complete the final quantitative H.1 bound.
The generic statements remain volume-almost-everywhere in thresholds, with the stated almost-everywhere base conclusion after Fubini; no all-threshold conclusion is inferred.
